metadata.title: Confirmed Phishing - IP Literal & Typosquatted Domain
metadata.raw_text: URGENT: Your account has been suspended due to unauthorized access. Verify your credentials immediately at http://192.168.1.10/login to restore access.

messages.text: I received this email saying my account was suspended and asking me to verify.
That is a confirmed phishing attempt. Do not click the link.

analysis.customer_request: The customer is instructed to verify their credentials to restore suspended account access.
analysis.recommended_action: Block the sender domain immediately and warn the user not to click the IP-based URL.

summary.issue: The customer received a phishing email claiming their account was suspended.
summary.customer_request: Verify the authenticity of the account suspension email.
summary.actions_taken: The agent confirmed the email is a phishing attempt and warned the customer not to click the link.

metadata.title: Credential Harvesting - Lookalike Security Alert
metadata.raw_text: Security Alert: Please update your password and provide your OTP code to maintain access: https://paypal-security-update.xyz

messages.text: Please check this link asking for my password and OTP.

analysis.customer_request: The customer received a suspicious security alert requiring password and OTP update.
analysis.recommended_action: Block the sender domain immediately and warn the user not to click the link or share their OTP.

metadata.title: Resolved Billing Overcharge
metadata.raw_text: I requested a refund for an overcharge of $40 on invoice #INV-9281.

messages.text: I requested a refund for an overcharge of $40 on invoice #INV-9281.
We reviewed the transaction and refunded $40 to your card.

analysis.customer_request: The customer is requesting a refund for a $40 overcharge on their invoice.
analysis.recommended_action: Verify invoice #INV-9281 and process the $40 refund for the customer.

summary.issue: The customer was overcharged $40 on invoice #INV-9281.
summary.customer_request: To receive a refund for the $40 overcharge.
summary.actions_taken: Support reviewed the transaction and successfully refunded $40 to the customer's card.

metadata.title: Unresolved Double Charge
metadata.raw_text: I was double charged $49.99 on my credit card for this month's subscription. Please issue a refund immediately.

messages.text: I was charged twice for my subscription this morning.
Still waiting for someone to help me, my card is blocked.

analysis.customer_request: The customer wants an immediate refund for a double charge on their subscription.
analysis.recommended_action: Verify the billing transaction and process a refund of $49.99 for the duplicate charge.

summary.issue: The customer was charged twice for their subscription, resulting in a blocked credit card.
summary.customer_request: To get assistance with the duplicate charge and the blocked card

metadata.title: Account Lockout & Password Reset
metadata.raw_text: My account has been locked after 3 failed login attempts. I am not receiving the password reset email.

messages.text: My account is locked and reset email isn't arriving.
Let me check your account status and send a manual unlock link.

analysis.customer_request: The customer wants to unlock their account and receive a password reset email.
analysis.recommended_action: Verify the customer's identity through standard support channels and manually trigger a password reset.

summary.issue: The customer's account is locked and they are not receiving the automated password reset email.
summary.customer_request: Unlock the account and regain access.
summary.actions_taken: The agent checked the account status and initiated a manual unlock link.

metadata.title: Delivery Package Missing
metadata.raw_text: Tracking number TRK-99281 shows package delivered yesterday, but nothing arrived at my address. Please help locate it.

messages.text: Tracking says delivered yesterday, but porch is empty.
We opened an investigation with the courier.

analysis.customer_request: Locate the missing package that was marked as delivered.
analysis.recommended_action: Check the delivery status with the courier and assist the customer with a missing package investigation.

summary.issue: The customer's package was marked as delivered by the courier, but it is missing from their porch.
summary.customer_request: Locate the missing package or receive a resolution for the undelivered item.
summary.actions_taken: Support has opened an investigation with the courier.

metadata.title: Technical 500 Internal Server Error
metadata.raw_text: The dashboard API returns 500 Internal Server Error when exporting monthly CSV reports. Our analytics pipeline is blocked.

messages.text: CSV export is throwing 500 server error.

analysis.customer_request: The customer wants to resolve the 500 Internal Server Error on the dashboard API to unblock their analytics pipeline.
analysis.recommended_action: Route the ticket to technical support to investigate the API 500 error during CSV exports.

summary.issue: The CSV export feature is currently failing and returning a 500 server error.
summary.customer_request: To be able to successfully export data to a CSV file without errors.
summary.actions_taken: Support informed the customer that engineering is deploying a hotfix.

metadata.title: Critical Compromised Admin Session
metadata.raw_text: Unauthorized login detected from an unknown IP address in Russia on our admin account. Please revoke all active sessions immediately.

messages.text: Emergency: unauthorized login from Russia on our admin profile!
Security SOC revoked all sessions and rotated API keys.

analysis.customer_request: The customer wants to revoke all active sessions immediately due to an unauthorized login.
analysis.recommended_action: Verify the identity of the user through out-of-band communication before taking administrative action on sessions.

summary.issue: An unauthorized admin login from Russia compromised the account.
summary.customer_request: Immediate assistance regarding a security breach.
summary.actions_taken: Security SOC revoked all sessions and rotated API keys.

metadata.title: Single-Message Invoice Update (Zero-Summary Case)
metadata.raw_text: Can you please update our company billing address and tax ID on our latest invoice #INV-2026-881?
messages: Customer: Can you please update our company billing address and tax ID on our latest invoice #INV-2026-881?

analysis.customer_request: The customer wants to update their company billing address and tax ID on the latest invoice.
analysis.recommended_action: Verify the customer's identity through standard internal authentication protocols before updating the billing details and tax ID on the invoice.
